headline: Mid-bounce into $1.18 resistance off the $1.049 low

meta.market_state_note: Capitulation low at $1.049 + counter-trend bounce into the $1.181-1.186 mean cluster; the daily is still bearish. Don't chase short below $1.18 — sell the tag of resistance on rejection, or stand aside. A held reclaim of $1.186 flips the read long toward $1.244.

factors.evidence: Long grind down from $1.55 (May), then an accelerating flush $1.33 to $1.049 over ~8 sessions. Fresh lower low; no break of structure to the upside.
Price $1.167 well below the 20 EMA (computed from daily closes).
Price below; 20 EMA ($1.244) below 50 EMA ($1.314) — bearish stack.
Oversold, sub-40 regime; ticking up off its MA but not out of bearish territory.
The two largest bars were the down-flush (616M, 403M) — capitulation; bounce volume fading (318 to 271 to 103M).
Since $1.049, a clean micro-uptrend: higher lows (1.049 to 1.088 to 1.12 to 1.137 to 1.155) and higher highs to $1.186. Counter-trend bounce.
Price stalling right at this cluster; not reclaimed.
Sell climax on the $1.049 print; up-bars ~50-67M but fading at resistance.

setup.thesis: Short the pullback into the $1.181-1.186 confluence (4H 50 EMA + 4H AVWAP + daily AVWAP) on rejection, targeting a retest of the $1.10 shelf and the $1.049 capitulation low. Do not chase short below $1.18, and do not flip long unless $1.186 is reclaimed and held.
setup.not: Not a long here (chasing +11% off the low into resistance); not mean reversion and not a reversal.

verdict.rationale: This is a developing continuation short, not a trade to put on at $1.167. Wait for price to tag $1.181-1.186 (4H 50 EMA + dual AVWAP) and reject it, then short with the bearish daily bias toward $1.10 / $1.049. Don't chase short below $1.18, and flip the read only if $1.186 is reclaimed and held.

Capitulation 616M/403M on the flush; bounce volume fading
HH/HL bounce off $1.049; reclaimed 4H 20 EMA — counter-trend
Stalling at $1.181-1.186 (4H 50 EMA + dual AVWAP); supply overhead
Below daily ($1.186) & at 4H ($1.185) AVWAP — not reclaimed
$1.049 swept sell-side stops then reclaimed (failed-breakdown tell)
Flushed 171 to 157M into the low, rebuilt to 175M on the bounce — fresh longs into resistance
-0.0026% (mildly negative) — shorts slightly crowded, modest squeeze-up risk
Higher low at the $1.049 price low (-2.16B to -1.85B), rising into the bounce = absorption
4H RSI 54 rising; daily RSI 34 turning up off oversold
PR Avg $1.13 below; PR Upper-1 $1.197 / daily 20 EMA $1.244 overhead supply

analyst_summary: XRP is bearish on the swing — the daily is below every mean (20 EMA $1.244, 50 EMA $1.314, AVWAP $1.186) with a fresh lower low at the $1.049 capitulation flush — but the 4H has bounced (HH/HL, reclaimed the 4H 20 EMA) into the $1.181-1.186 mean cluster.

The play is to sell the rally into resistance with the dominant bearish bias, not to chase a +11% bounce: short the $1.181-1.186 tag on rejection, stop above $1.20, targeting $1.10 then the $1.049 low (~1:4.9 / ~1:7.9).

The real caveat is a textbook capitulation signature at $1.049 — CVD higher-low absorption, an OI long-flush, and mildly negative funding — so a held reclaim of $1.186 flips the read long toward $1.244; respect that line in both directions.

BTC dependency: the $1.049 flush looks like a broad liquidation cascade, so this short assumes BTC stays heavy — a strong BTC bid would likely drag XRP through $1.186 and invalidate it. Data caveat: the chart's EMA studies failed to load, so the 20/50 EMA values are computed from the Bybit close series.
bottom_line: Trend-following continuation short within a bearish daily trend — but a developing one: sell the $1.181-1.186 rejection, don't short the hole. A held reclaim of $1.186 flips it long.

Volume fades into resistance / expands on the turn down

bull_case: Capitulation at $1.049 (climax volume + CVD higher-low absorption + OI long-flush + negative funding) plus a 4H HH/HL reclaim — a bounce that extends to the daily 20 EMA $1.244.
bear_case: Daily below every mean with a fresh LL, and the bounce stalling dead at the $1.181-1.186 supply with OI rebuilding into it — a dead-cat to be sold for a retest of $1.10 / $1.049.
failure_scenario: The $1.049 low holds, CVD absorption proves a real bottom, price reclaims $1.186 and squeezes the freshly-rebuilt shorts up to the daily 20 EMA ($1.244).
derivatives_summary: Selling was flushed out at $1.049 and buyers stepped in (CVD absorption, OI long-flush, slightly negative funding) — flow leans bounce-supportive, which is the main risk to the continuation short until $1.186 rejects.
conclusion: Trend-Following Continuation Short within a bearish daily trend — a developing short that needs the $1.181-1.186 rejection to confirm; explicitly not a long here and not mean reversion.
